content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SAIL Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SAIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for SAIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the SAIL recruitment is scheduled to be held on 16 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Dresser cum Compounder post?
faq.answer: For the Dresser cum Compounder post, candidates must have passed Intermediate (10+2) with Science and possess a Diploma or Certificate in Dresser/Compounder.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Nurse (Female) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Nurse (Female) post is 30 years. Age relaxations are applicable for OBC, SC, and ST categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for these proficiency training posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a stipend of Rs. 10000/- per month, along with a Knowledge Enhancement Allowance of up to Rs. 7020/- based on attendance.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Dresser cum Compounder (Male) post?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies available for the Dresser cum Compounder (Male) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need to bring original and self-attested copies of qualification certificates, Aadhar Card, PAN Card, Birth Certificate, Caste Certificate, Address Proof, and passport-size photos.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview, Document Verification, and a Medical Checkup.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for SAIL recruitment being conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at SAIL, Chandrapur Ferro Alloy Plant, Chandrapur, Maharashtra, 442401.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies announced by SAIL?
faq.answer: Steel Authority of India (SAIL) has announced a total of 4 vacancies for the Proficiency Training of Dresser cum Compounder (Male) and Nurse (Female) posts.
